best_for: PC builders and overclockers on Windows who need to read the exact CPU, motherboard and RAM details, such as memory timings and SPD data, without opening the case.

points.title: What it tells you
points.text: It shows the processor name, codename, process and cache levels, the motherboard and chipset, memory type, size and timings, and per-module SPD data. Core and memory clocks update live.

points.title: Proof for forums
points.text: Press F7 to save a validation file, or submit results to CPUID's online validator to share a verified record of your system.

points.title: Free, Windows only
points.text: CPU-Z is freeware for Windows x86 and x64 and fully supports Windows 11. There is no Mac or Linux version.

points.title: Installer or zip
points.text: Each release comes as a setup or a zip, both with 32-bit and 64-bit builds. The zip runs without installing, which suits a USB toolkit.

points.title: New chips need new builds
points.text: Support for new processors arrives in updates; 3.02 from 4 November 2026 added Intel Razor Lake. Keep it current on new hardware. The Windows listing keeps 31 versions if a new build misreads an older system.

points.title: Brand editions exist
points.text: CPUID also offers skinned builds for ASUS ROG, MSI, Gigabyte, AORUS, Cooler Master and ASRock boards. They show the same data in a vendor look.
